data.define: A polite way to say no or that you're okay.

misuse.text: Don't say 'I'm good' if you want more food.

publish.title: What does "I'm good" mean?
publish.value: I'm good = No thanks, I'm fine. Example: "No thanks, I'm good." (casual English, US).
